resources.string: A big button: tap it and tell Alyosha what you need
For family members. Tap each amber tile and allow it. A green frame with a check mark means done.
This changes everything: on-screen text, the assistant\'s speech and voice commands. After switching, the first load of speech recognition takes up to a minute.
1. Permissions: microphone, contacts, calls, SMS, answering calls, location
2. Display over other apps (greeting on the side button and answering calls by voice)
3. Battery: no restrictions (otherwise the system stops the assistant)
5. A voice for the selected language. If it isn\'t checked, install one in text-to-speech settings (Google)
… 6. Loading speech recognition (the first start takes up to a minute)
✓ The wake word works: say «rest» to let the assistant rest, «Alyosha» or «Alex» to wake it
✗ The recognizer doesn\'t know the wake word; wake the assistant by tapping the screen
7. Autostart (Tecno/Infinix): app settings open → turn on Autostart and allow background activity
Also on Tecno: Settings → Battery → App management → the assistant → No restrictions. Lock the app in recent apps (padlock) so cleanup doesn\'t close it.
Xiaomi permissions: turn on «Display pop-up windows while running in the background» and «Show on lock screen»
Xiaomi autostart: turn it on for the assistant
Without these, Xiaomi won\'t let the assistant open on «Алёша» while the screen is off. Also: Settings → Apps → the assistant → Battery saver → No restrictions.
8. Optional: make it the home screen (the assistant opens right away on the side button)
Tip: turn off the screen lock (Settings → Security → Screen lock → None) so nothing needs to be swiped.
Weather comes from Open-Meteo: now, in 1–2 hours, tomorrow and the day after. Needs internet and location.
Listen for «Alyosha» whenever the assistant isn\'t on screen (tap to listen only while resting)
Listen for «Alyosha» only while resting (tap to always listen)
«Always» is more convenient but uses more battery.

If «heard» is lower than the number of times you called, background mic access is limited (battery, Xiaomi permissions). If «opened» is lower than «heard», the system blocks the window (Xiaomi: pop-up windows in the background).
No voices are downloaded for this language. Tap step 5 and download one in Google settings.
Tap a voice to hear it; it becomes the assistant\'s voice. Pick a calm male one. If there isn\'t one: step 5 → language → download more voices.
The assistant recognizes a contact by the words in its name. Short names work best: «Daughter», «Son Andrew». ✗ means the recognizer doesn\'t know the word; rename the contact.
The check becomes available once speech recognition has loaded.
Tap the screen and say what you need
Tap the screen to give a command
Say «Alyosha» or tap the screen to call me
Reads all on-screen text aloud when you say «read the screen». The screen edges glow while it reads. To stop: tap the screen, press a volume button or say «Alyosha, stop».
9. Screen reading: Accessibility → «Alyosha: screen reading» → turn on

Say «read the screen» (or «Alyosha, read the screen» while the assistant is hidden) to hear everything on screen. If the switch is greyed out: Settings → Apps → the assistant → ⋮ → «Allow restricted settings», then come back here.
When you call «Alyosha», the assistant answers: «What can I do for you, John?» Leave it empty for no name.
High — easy to call, but sometimes reacts to other speech
Hard to call? Go higher. Reacts to TV and videos? Go lower.
✓ Echo cancellation is on: the assistant doesn\'t hear its own voice (%1$s)
✗ This phone has no echo cancellation; the assistant may hear its own voice (%1$s)

«Message my daughter» — the assistant asks where (SMS or Max) and what, reads it back and sends it. «Text my daughter» or «…on Max» skips the question. Max needs screen reading (step 9); don\'t touch the screen while it sends.
Capture a Max screen report (for the developer)
10. Notification access: «Alyosha: who wrote» → turn on
Needed for «who wrote?»: the assistant says who wrote and where — SMS, Max, Telegram, WhatsApp. If the switch is greyed out, use «Allow restricted settings» as for screen reading.
